chapter: Radio color line, San Francisco and Columbia staff
title: Duke and Blanton on radio, and when Lee went on staff
summary: Lee recalls Duke and Blanton on Bing Crosby's show and says he joined Columbia's staff in 1945 or 1946.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Louis used to do guest shots with Bing Crosby, and Duke used to do a lot of guest shots on radio, as a duo though. Duke and Jimmy Blanton. They used to do a lot of things on radio -- on big radio shows. You'd very often hear Blanton and Duke playing together.

Well, the one I really remember is -- it was the Bing Crosby Show, one of them, but I used to have -- someplace at home, I have one of the shows, you know? I have it someplace at home, down in the basement someplace, but I do have one of them.

Uh huh, I have one of the transcriptions someplace at home. But that's about the size of it. I remember Duke and I remember -- I'm speaking now about here in the west -- but now, I used to listen to John Kirby coming from New York and Procope, when he had Maxine Sullivan, you know, and they used to come on every Saturday morning, or something of the sort. But out here, as far as musicians were concerned; that is, the black musicians, I guess I was the one who was fortunate enough to get involved with the studios.
So it was what year that you went on staff?
Well, I didn't go on staff until like, '45, I think, '45 or '46.
'45, or '46, I think. That was at Columbia Studios over on Gower. But after this incident with the radio show.
